updateMessage: Movie Hub v3.5.270 is live! Instant movie/series click-to-play, dual touch gestures for volume & brightness, seamless quality switch resume, strictly 2026 releases on Featured & Latest rows, and ~90 MB build.
releaseNotes: v3.5.270: Movies and web series start immediately on click. Screen gestures (right side vertical swipe for volume up/down, left side for brightness). Seamless video quality change without resetting to 0. Featured slider and Latest section strictly display 2026 releases only. ~90 MB APK build.
